The test image shows a young soybean plant with scattered, small, light green to yellow spots on the upper leaf surface. The spots are diffuse, not angular or vein-limited, and show no browning or necrosis yet — consistent with early-stage infection.

Key observations:
- Small, pale yellow-green spots scattered across leaf surfaces
- No angular shape or water-soaking (rules out Bacterial Blight)
- No raised pustules (rules out Bacterial Pustule)
- No vein-associated necrosis (rules out Soybean Vein Necrosis)
- Not a mottled/puckered pattern (rules out Bean Pod Mottle)
- Matches Downy mildew description: "Small light green spots on upper leaf surfaces that enlarge and turn pale to bright yellow"
- Downy mildew reference images (especially bottom-left panel) show very similar scattered yellow-green spotting
